title: Clean tool-driven pipeline task routing (advance_task / reject_task) and sensor enforcement
diff_summary: 1. src-tauri/src/agent.rs: Added advance_task and reject_task canonical tools with strict parameters. advance_task advances task to next pipeline column, sets terminal tasks to 'done', executes move_task_stage (sensors & hooks), writes summary to dialog history, and emits task:moved. reject_task moves card back with 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' and 'idle' status, emits reject reason, and enforces ironclad invariant forbidding return to backlog from stage 1. 2. src-tauri/src/commands.rs: Removed automatic post-loop stage advancement in run_agent — cards move ONLY upon explicit advance_task/reject_task calls, otherwise transitioning to 'idle' in current column. Factored internal_move_task_stage and append_task_dialog_activity with SQLite persistence. 3. src-tauri/src/config.rs: Added advance_task and reject_task to CANONICAL_TOOLS and DEFAULT_TOOL_POLICY (enabled by default). 4. src/stores/toolPolicyStore.ts & src/components/settings/ToolPolicyModal.tsx: Added advance_task and reject_task to Workflow category ('Управление задачами') with category grouping in matrix and global tabs. 5. src/stores/boardStore.ts: Removed unsafe local fallback that bypassed gatekeeper sensors, adding rollback via loadTasks() and sensor error alert on rejection.
notes: Autonomous tool-driven pipeline task routing successfully implemented and verified. Gatekeeper sensors cannot be bypassed. Worktree cleaned up and changes merged to main.
